title: DualFeat-SEW-CLIF MI-EEG frozen reproducibility evidence archive
description: Source-maintenance patch for the frozen DualFeat-SEW-CLIF MI-EEG reproducibility release. Version 1.0.1 adds manuscript and figure audit utilities, restores historical launch helpers, and extends the V25 integrity manifest without changing frozen trial predictions, metrics, checkpoints, or scientific conclusions. Raw and processed EEG signals and feature caches remain excluded because of third-party dataset licensing.
